data.name: Mirsal
data.gender_notes: Mirsal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'r-s-l' meaning 'to guide, command, or lead'. In Islamic history, Mirsal is a title given to important leaders and guides. The name Mirsal carries the meaning “Guide, Commander, Leader” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mirsal usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, commander, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes guidance and leadership from Allah.
data.etymology: Mirsal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Commander, Leader.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mirsal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ميرصَل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يُشير إلى المسؤولية والمسؤولية الدينية
in_arabic.long_meaning: المُرسَل: اسم علم مؤكد يعني المسؤولية والمسؤولية الدينية، ويمثل الشخص المؤمن الذي يُرسل الله لخدمة الناس ويُحفزهم على الطريق الصحيح، ويتماشى مع القيمة الإسلامية للتوحيد والتواصل مع الله، ويُشير إلى دور الفرد في نشر الحق والعدل والتصديق في الله.

in_urdu.name: ميرصَل
in_urdu.long_meaning: مرسل کا نام ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے حکم سے مسلمانوں کی مدد اور فلاح کے لیے بھیجے جاتے ہیں، ان کی ایمانداری اور نیک اعمال کے لیے جانتے ہیں، ایک مسلمان کے لیے بھیجا گیا ہے، ان کے کاموں میں اللہ کے احکامات کی پابندی اور دوسروں کی مدد کرنا شامل ہوتا ہے،

in_hindi.name: मिर्सल
in_hindi.meaning: हिंदू धर्म का एक संत का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिरसल नाम का अर्थ है भेजा हुआ, जो कि एक धर्मग्रंथ में वर्णित है, जो कि मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक पवित्र व्यक्ति का नाम है जो कि दूसरों की मदद करता है और उन्हें सही राह पर ले जाता है, मिरसल नाम के लोगों को अक्सर नेक इरादों वाले और मुस्लिम समुदाय के महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्तियों के रूप में देखा जाता है, जो कि दूसरों की मदद करते हैं और उनकी जरूरतों का ध्यान रखते हैं

in_pashto.name: میرصَل

in_english.long_meaning: Mirsal is a name that signifies a person sent by God to spread Islam and promote justice, representing a faithful individual who is entrusted with the responsibility of serving humanity and guiding them on the right path, aligning with the Islamic value of monotheism and communication with God, and symbolizing the role of an individual in disseminating truth and promoting fairness and conviction in God.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun records the title 'Mir Sa'id al-Mamun' for a governor in the Maghreb in the late 14th century.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun's 'The Muqaddimah' describes the political landscape of the Islamic world during this era, including the role and titles of various governors and rulers.

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqdisi mentions 'Mir' as a title for governors in the Fatimid Caliphate in the 10th century Egypt.
historical_references.context: Al-Maqdisi's 'Ahbar Maqamat al-Arab' is a travelogue detailing the geography and peoples of the Islamic world, and includes references to various titles and offices held by rulers and officials during this time.
